value.rationale: Vertex-preserving bistellar flips are the natural local moves on a triangulated surface. Because eight vertices is the minimal Klein-bottle stratum and Cervone's classification contains all six types, the complete flip quotient is a natural finite moduli graph rather than an arbitrary slice. The result exposes structural asymmetry: 404 is uniquely peripheral, only 161 and 1133 support self-flips, and every type lies within three flips of every other type.
